p: leviathan with an hook: Meaning the whale.
bore his jaw through with a: Because he fears lest you should take him.
him for a servant for ever: To do your business, and be at your command?
the battle: If you once consider the danger, you will not meddle with him.
the hope of him is in: That is, that trusts to take him.
stand before me: If no one dare stand against a whale, which is but a creature, who is able to compare with God the creator?
repay him: Who has taught me to accomplish my work?
his parts: The parts and members of the whale?
of his garment: That is, who dare pull off his skin?
bridle: Who dare put a bridle in his mouth?
open the doors of his face: Who dare look in his mouth?
a light doth shine: That is, casts out flames of fire.
sorrow is turned into joy before: Nothing is painful or hard for him.
are under him: His skin is so hard that he lies with a great ease on the stones as in the mud.
boil like a pot: Either he makes the sea to seem like it is boiling by his wallowing, or else he spouts water in such abundance as it would seem that the sea boiled.
shine after him: That is, a white froth and shining stream before him.
all high things: He despises all other beasts and monsters, and is the proudest of all others.
